questions.stem: What is the primary purpose of preparing a statement of affairs?

options.text: To determine the profit of a business.
To show the assets and liabilities at a specific point in time.
To calculate the total sales of a business.
To record all transactions in a business.

questions.explanation: A statement of affairs is used to show the assets and liabilities of a business at a specific point in time, similar to a balance sheet.

distractorRationale.a: While profit can be derived from the statement of affairs, its primary purpose is to show assets and liabilities.
distractorRationale.c: Total sales are not directly shown in a statement of affairs.
distractorRationale.d: Recording transactions is not the purpose of a statement of affairs.

questions.stem: How do you calculate profit using the statement of affairs method?

options.text: Closing Capital - Opening Capital + Additional Capital - Drawings
Closing Capital + Drawings - Additional Capital - Opening Capital
Opening Capital + Additional Capital - Drawings - Closing Capital
Closing Capital + Opening Capital - Additional Capital + Drawings

questions.explanation: The correct formula for calculating profit from incomplete records is Closing Capital + Drawings - Additional Capital - Opening Capital.

distractorRationale.a: This formula incorrectly adds additional capital instead of subtracting it.
distractorRationale.c: This formula incorrectly subtracts closing capital and adds opening capital.
distractorRationale.d: This formula incorrectly adds both opening capital and drawings.

questions.stem: Which of the following is NOT required to calculate profit using the statement of affairs method?
questions.explanation: Total sales are not directly required in the formula for calculating profit using the statement of affairs method.

distractorRationale.a: Opening capital is required to determine the change in capital.
distractorRationale.b: Closing capital is necessary to assess the end financial position.
distractorRationale.d: Drawings must be accounted for as they affect the capital.
